content: Baratǝrdabarǝg Yesu kǝ shig kǝ mbǝrzahaana

Lakwti ɓag sarta Hwaɗaga Haarakǝsa Dzǝva Hǝnnyaha, sǝrghaakasǝrǝg Yesu taakiya ɓaagɓag sartaan kwada ɗuug nǝ iin kǝ duni kiyava gwiya daas da vak Daada. Waighantwaig tsau Yesu kǝ uudahaan ma duniya, dlaɓ maratǝrdamarǝg kǝ waiyakǝvaan tangw dat ghaalaana.
Lakwti za kafa hwaas kǝ Yesu ard mbǝrzahaana, fagharafǝg Shatanah kǝ Yahuda, zǝra Saminu Iskariyoti kǝ vǝla Yesu.
Sǝrgasǝrǝg Yesu taakiya, fadǝmfǝg Daad kǝ dǝgitah miizha dǝvaan baɗǝmma, dlaɓa sǝrgasǝrǝg sahi vak Daadamazhigǝla, da gwiiya daas da vak Daadamazhigǝla.
Ma sartǝn ar za kafna, kaa ciigǝtciig Yesu, tsugda kǝ sǝɗavaani gyimala, kǝsant kǝ patkara sǝɗav nguɗǝs tǝ ngyilaana.
Tǝhala kwaha gǝt kǝ iin kǝ yu ma kuwa, farzha kǝ bara shigaha mbǝrzahaana, dǝrda kǝ shigahaatǝr dǝ patkara sǝɗav kwa nguɗǝs nǝ iin tǝ ngyilaanna.
Kaa sagauw kǝ Yesu da vak Bitrus. Am Bitrus taa kǝ iina, “Yazhǝgǝla, kǝgh wa da bargwa shigahara?”
Kaa ngugangug Yesu taakiya, “Agha sǝrga bi kǝ dǝgit ǝn ɓag nai ndakwan biya, agha da nǝghǝgaaka tǝ hala.”
Aiyam Bitrus taa kǝ iina, “Maaya! agha tapna bi kǝ bargwa shigahar biya.” Kaa ngugarangug kǝ Yesu, amaa, “Ai ciya, akwama barankada biya, agha maay ǝmtaɗ dǝ kai biya.”
Aiyam Bitrus taa kǝ iina, “Yazhigǝla, aa ɗuug kǝ shigahar kalti biya, baz dǝvvahara ard ghǝrara.”
Am Yesu taa kǝ iina, “Akwama baraabarǝg nǝ uuda, baɗǝm nǝ vǝghaan ba cuwaɗaɗɗa. Madlai lambaan dǝ barg biya, bamma barda kǝ shigahaan kaltiya. Aɗaba am ba cuwaɗaɗɗa, bakǝvakwaha, ɗǝmaru biya.”
Aɗaba sǝrgasǝrǝg kǝ daddakwa da za langyiyaana, iinwa tag nǝ iin taakiya, “Kuram ɗǝm bi wa cuwaɗaɗ biya.”
Ghyǝnnga ba nǝ iin bartǝr shiggahatǝra, kaa gwiya tsǝgwǝv kǝ sǝɗɗavaana, kaa gwiiya kǝ iin davak ndzǝggaanana. Kaa ndavǝtǝrndavǝg kǝ iina amaa, “Nǝghǝghamakanǝghǝg kǝ dǝgit ǝnna ɓagkur naiya?
Am ɗaa kai dǝ dadda tsaga dǝgita, dlaɓa Yazhǝgǝla. Ba kalkalla, aɗaɓa ǝn band kwaha naiya.
Ən Yazhǝgǝlaruwa ard Daddatsaga dǝgitaru tsauwa, barrankurdabarǝg kǝ shiga, kats kuram ndakwi barari am barrgarbarrǝg kǝ shig kǝ zaraabahaaruwa.
Marankurdamarǝg kǝ garav kǝyavva ɓagaan kǝskuram band kwana ɓakura naiya.
Bak jiijiira ǝn tagkurtaga, kwatnaha jigubi kǝ daddahǝnǝhya biya, zǝrɓǝllǝg dlaɓa jiguwi kǝ daddakwa ɓǝllǝgaan biya.
Ndakwanna am asǝrgasǝrg tsau kǝ kwannahaan kǝ dǝgitaha, akwaman ɓagaana am da dǝ barka.

Ən tag tǝghǝr kǝsskuram ɗǝm biya. Ən sǝrgasǝrǝg kǝ uudahi dzǝrantǝraaka naiya. Kwannǝn dlaɓa kwakyarvad righǝvant nǝ dǝgit ma kakaɗa Dadamazhǝgǝla taakiya, ‘Daddakwa kǝm zaa kaf ǝmǝtaɗa nalnǝg kǝ tlǝghumara.’
Ən tagkurtag ndakwana lakuti dzǝgaadzǝga, aɗaba ma da dzǝghaardzǝga, famdǝghǝrǝtfǝg taakiya ba kaiyina.

Bak jiijiira ǝn tagkurtaga, daddakwa dlǝghadlǝg kǝ daddakwana ɓǝlgant nai bad rivǝɗmahuɗ palla, dlǝghaakwidlǝg kǝsskaiya. Dlaɓa daddakwa dlǝghaakwidlǝg kǝsskaiya dlǝghaadlǝg kǝ daddakwa ɓallakwadi kaiya.”
Za lanngyiya Yesu
Tǝhala tagdataga Yesu kwanen kǝ ǝlbǝga, mbakǝnmbǝg ma ǝrivɗyana. Kaa tagaan kǝ iin bat ɓallaɓal taakiya, “Bak jiijiira, ǝn tagkurtaga, pallaruwa da vǝlkwavǝlǝga.”
Kaa vazakǝv kǝ mbǝrzahaan mataatakaatǝra, aɗaba ar sǝrgai kǝ mbǝrzi tag nǝ Yesu kǝ ǝlbǝg tǝghǝr biya.
Pal ma mbǝrzahaana, kwa waig nǝ iina, ndzǝgaan bahyǝf dǝ inna,
Wiika am nǝ Bitrus dǝ dǝv taa kǝ mbǝrzǝna, ndavarundavǝg kǝ Yesu tag tǝghǝr kǝ warra.
Kaa dǝngzharva kǝ mbǝrzǝn tǝvǝgh kǝ Yesu ndavaruwa amaa, “War wahiin, Yazhigǝli?”

Aiyam nǝ Yesu taa kǝ iina, “Ən da hǝgaan kǝ ghudǝga bruudi damma taasa. Dadakwan da vǝlga naiya, iin nǝ uuda nǝ iina.” Kǝssghant ba nǝ Yesu kǝ ghudǝga bruudin hǝdǝmma, kaa vǝlla kǝ iin kǝ Yahuda zǝra siman Iskariyoti.
Cauwa ba nǝ iin kǝ ghudǝga bruudi kaa dass kǝ shatanah dama vǝghaana bawatswatsa. Kaa am Yesu kǝ Yahuda, “Dǝginǝn aghanaa ɓag nǝngnaa ɓag bawatswatsa.”
Maay ma lii za kafǝn wa nǝghǝghakanǝghǝg kǝ dǝgit tuuk vakaiy wa taghar nǝ Yesu kǝ iin biya.
Yahuda tsau wa hǝkya ambǝlla kwaɓatǝra, kyǝlǝma mbǝrzaah tlatlar ba taakiya tagghar aa sǝgwasǝgw kǝ dǝgit naahaava kwakyarvad haarakǝssa nǝ Yesu, bi vǝllǝtǝr kǝ dǝgit kǝ talaggaha.
Cauwa ba nǝ iin kǝ ghudǝga bruudina, kaa dagalaana. Masarta kwaha ndza avǝɗ vakka.
Dalla adzahadzaha
Tǝhala kwa dagal Yahuda, am Yesu, “Aa fǝvvaara ndakwan nǝ Zǝr Uuda, dlaɓa faavaarafǝg nǝ Dadamazhǝgǝl tǝdǝvad iina.
Akwama fǝvaarafǝg nǝ Dadamazhǝgǝl tǝdǝvad iina, Dadamazhǝgǝl da fǝgaarafǝg kǝ zǝraan bad ghǝraana, dlaɓa da fǝgaarafǝga bawatswatsa.
“Kuram Zarhara, tǝmma bahǝɗiikǝn nǝ ndzǝgana ǝmǝtaɗ dǝ kurama. Am da gatkwagatǝga, bandkwa tagantǝr nai kǝ yaa Yahud taakiya, ‘Ən tagkurtag bandakwanna, Vakavaki ǝn da dagal naiya am da sǝgǝv biya.’
“Dalla adzahadzah wan vǝllǝkur naiya, waiyamwaig kǝ uuda. Bandkwan waiyankurǝt naiya, kuram ndakwi waiyamwaig kǝ uudaha.
Tǝdǝvad kwamam waigaan kǝ uuda da sǝrǝggasǝrǝg aanji war taakiya am mbǝrzahaara.”
Da ɓalgaan nǝ Bitrus agajawa sǝrga bi kǝ Yesu.
Ndavǝgharundavǝg Siman Bitrus kǝ Yesu amaa, “Yaazhigǝla, agha da dagal da vakwari?” Ngughaarangug nǝ Yesu amaa, “Ndakwana vakavaki ǝn da dagal naiya agha da gatkus biya, tǝhala agha da gatkusgatǝga.”
Aiyam Bitrus taa kǝ iina, “Yazhigǝla, aujilbǝg ǝn gatkǝsi ndakwan biyi? Ən da vǝlgaan kǝ shifǝgar kwakyarvad kǝgha.”
Aiyam nǝ Yesu taa kǝ iina, “Aaya, agha da vǝlgaan kǝ shifǝgagh kwakyarvad kaiya? Bak jiijiira, ǝn tagkataga, lakwti wiig ghwatkal agha da ɓalgaan kǝ agajauwa sǝrkwa bi shig hǝkǝrɗa.”
